description: Signal queries for elements, components or directives in the component's own template.
Signal queries for nodes projected into the component through `<ng-content>`.
`viewChild.required()` / `contentChild.required()` return a non-undefined signal and throw if the match is missing.
Chooses what the query returns from a matched node: `ElementRef`, `ViewContainerRef`, `TemplateRef` or a directive.
Legacy result type of `@ViewChildren`/`@ContentChildren` with a `changes` observable.
Content query option to match nested nodes instead of only direct children.
